requirement_text: System shall provide comprehensive documentation and support resources for users and administrators.
user_story: As a user or administrator, I want documentation and support resources, so that I can learn to use and run the system.
technical_task: Provide documentation and support resources for users and for administrators.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system, when a user looks for help, then documentation and support resources for users are available.
Given the system, when an administrator looks for help, then documentation and support resources for administrators are available.
rationale: Role stated: users and administrators. "Comprehensive" is not measured.

requirement_text: The storage temperature range shall be from - 30º to + 60º C.
requirement_text_raw: The storage temperature range shall (3.2.3.1.1.4) be from - 30º to + 60º C.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the storage temperature range to be from -30 to +60 degrees C, so that the unit survives storage.
technical_task: Qualify the unit for storage between -30 and +60 degrees C.
acceptance_criteria: Given the unit stored at -30 degrees C, when it is later powered on, then it works.
Given the unit stored at +60 degrees C, when it is later powered on, then it works.
rationale: Role assumed: hardware engineer. The degree symbols in the source are garbled and read as degrees C.

requirement_text: A team member shall meet with DIS/cloud.gov to determine requirements for the beta.nsf.gov ATO.
rationale: The sentence describes a meeting by a team member, not behaviour of the system.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement on the system or a project task?
What requirements for the ATO are to be determined?

requirement_text: Start Up shall be able to synchronize all operational FCPs in the presence of this skew in the power on sequence.
requirement_text_raw: Start Up shall (3.3.2.18) be able to synchronize all operational FCPs in the presence of this skew in the power on sequence.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Start Up to synchronize all operational FCPs despite the skew in the power on sequence, so that all FCPs start in step.
technical_task: Make Start Up synchronize all operational FCPs even when the power on sequence has the described skew.
acceptance_criteria: Given the skew in the power on sequence, when Start Up runs, then all operational FCPs are synchronized.
Given FCPs powered on at different times within the skew, when Start Up completes, then they are synchronized.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. "This skew" is defined earlier and not shown.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to validate and monitor time series data for correct order, valid values, and out-of-tolerance conditions.
user_story: As a data analyst, I want time series data validated and monitored for correct order, valid values and out-of-tolerance conditions, so that bad data is caught.
technical_task: Validate and monitor time series data for order, valid values and out-of-tolerance conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Given time series data in the wrong order, when it is validated, then the order problem is reported.
Given time series data with invalid values or an out-of-tolerance condition, when it is monitored, then the problem is reported.

requirement_text: The system shall be intuitive and self explanatory.
requirement_text_raw: The system shall be intuitive and self explanatory.'
rationale: "Intuitive" and "self explanatory" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: How is "intuitive and self explanatory" measured?
Which user group and which tasks apply?

requirement_text: The system shall display the searched information to the user.
user_story: As a user, I want the information I searched for displayed, so that I see the answer to my search.
technical_task: Display the information found by a search.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search with matching information, when it completes, then the information is displayed.
Given a search with no matching information, when it completes, then nothing is displayed.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to perform basic mathematical operations (+, -, *, /) on data in cells.
user_story: As a spreadsheet user, I want basic mathematical operations (+, -, *, /) on data in cells, so that I can calculate in the sheet.
technical_task: Support addition, subtraction, multiplication and division on data in cells.
acceptance_criteria: Given numbers in cells, when the user applies +, -, * or /, then the result is calculated.
Given a cell with the result, when the underlying cells change, then the result is shown for the new values.
rationale: Role assumed: spreadsheet user. The second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: The product shall be easy to use by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. 95% of Adjusters and Collision Estimators shall find the product easy to use.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall be easy to use by Adjusters and Collision Estimators.  95\% of Adjusters and Collision Estimators shall find the product easy to use.'
user_story: As an Adjuster or Collision Estimator, I want the product easy to use, with 95% of us finding it easy, so that I can work efficiently.
technical_task: Design the product so 95% of Adjusters and Collision Estimators find it easy to use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a survey of Adjusters and Collision Estimators, when the results are counted, then 95% find the product easy to use.
Given fewer than 95% find it easy to use, when the results are evaluated, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role stated: Adjusters and Collision Estimators.

requirement_text: An LHCP views the number of submitted physiologic data monitoring reports of his or her patients for the current date.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want the number of submitted physiologic data monitoring reports of my patients for today, so that I know what has come in.
technical_task: Show the LHCP the count of physiologic data monitoring reports submitted today by the LHCP's patients.
acceptance_criteria: Given patients who submitted physiologic data monitoring reports today, when the LHCP views the number, then it equals the count of those reports.
Given reports submitted on earlier dates, when the LHCP views the number for the current date, then they are not counted.

requirement_text: The system shall verify if the image adheres to a standard format.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to check that an image uses a standard format, so that unsupported files are caught.
technical_task: Check each image against a standard format.
acceptance_criteria: Given an image in a standard format, when the system verifies it, then it is accepted.
Given an image that does not adhere to a standard format, when the system verifies it, then it is flagged.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The standard formats are not listed.

requirement_text: The BE shall be able to apply normalizations based on reported data invalid counts.
user_story: As an observatory engineer, I want the BE to apply normalizations based on reported data invalid counts, so that data is corrected for invalid samples.
technical_task: Apply normalizations in the BE using the reported data invalid counts.
acceptance_criteria: Given reported data invalid counts, when the BE processes the data, then it applies normalizations based on them.
Given no invalid counts, when the BE processes the data, then no invalid-count normalization is applied.

requirement_text: When you are finished click 'Save'.
rationale: The sentence is guidance to a user with no stated system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or an instruction to the user?

requirement_text: The product shall have the ability to receive automatic software updates as new threats emerge. 100% of customers will be able to receive automatic software updates transmitted to the installed product.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall have the ability to receive automatic software updates as new threats emerge.  100\% of customers will be able to receive automatic software updates transmitted to the installed product.'
user_story: As a customer, I want the product to receive automatic software updates as new threats emerge, so that I stay protected.
technical_task: Deliver software updates automatically to all installed products as new threats emerge, so that 100% of customers can receive them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new threat emerges, when an update is released, then it is transmitted to the installed product automatically.
Given all customers, when an update is released, then 100% of them can receive it.

requirement_text: The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.
requirement_text_raw: The product should be able to be used by 90\% of novice users on the Internet.'
user_story: As a novice user, I want the product usable by 90% of novice users on the Internet, so that I can use it without experience.
technical_task: Design the product so that 90% of novice Internet users can use it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a group of novice Internet users, when they try the product, then 90% can use it.
Given fewer than 90% can use it, when the results are evaluated, then the recommendation is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: novice user. "Should" makes the figure a recommendation.

requirement_text: Only authorized users shall have access to the portion of the system that interfaces with CampusConnect.
requirement_text_raw: Only authorized users shall have access to the portion of the system that interfaces with CampusConnect.'
user_story: As a security officer, I want only authorized users to access the part of the system that interfaces with CampusConnect, so that the interface is protected.
technical_task: Restrict the CampusConnect interface portion of the system to authorized users.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized user, when the user opens the portion that interfaces with CampusConnect, then access is granted.
Given a user who is not authorized, when the user tries to open it, then access is denied.

requirement_text: The system shall be capable of supporting multiple languages for user interface and data presentation.
user_story: As a user, I want the interface and data presentation in multiple languages, so that I can use my own language.
technical_task: Support several languages for the user interface and the presentation of data.
acceptance_criteria: Given the language options, when the user selects a language, then the user interface is shown in it.
Given data, when it is presented in the selected language, then its presentation follows that language.

requirement_text: OpenEMR's calendar system includes a status indicator allowing doctors and staff to see at a glance what is going on with all appointments and the corresponding encounters for the day.
requirement_text_raw: OpenEMR's calendar system includes a status indicator  allowing doctors and staff to see at a glance what is going on with all appointments and the corresponding encounters for the day.
rationale: The sentence describes an existing feature of OpenEMR and states no requirement for this system.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a product description?
What must the status indicator show and for which statuses?

requirement_text: For slipping and closed NAK (clutch picture 1,2 ,4,7) the following is valid: The minimum power train torque is the addition of the maximum permissible drag torque of combustion engine and the idle speed controller desired torque (idle speed controller output and disturbance variable compensation).
user_story: As a powertrain engineer, I want the minimum power train torque for slipping and closed NAK to be the sum of the maximum permissible drag torque of the combustion engine and the idle speed controller desired torque, so that torque is bounded from below.
technical_task: Compute the minimum power train torque for slipping and closed NAK as the addition of the maximum permissible drag torque of the combustion engine and the idle speed controller desired torque (idle speed controller output and disturbance variable compensation).
acceptance_criteria: Given a slipping or closed NAK, when the minimum power train torque is determined, then it is the sum of the maximum permissible drag torque of the combustion engine and the idle speed controller desired torque.
Given the idle speed controller desired torque, when it is used, then it comprises the idle speed controller output and the disturbance variable compensation.
rationale: Role assumed: powertrain engineer. The clutch pictures referred to are not given.

requirement_text: (3) The audit log must record the information specified in sections 7.2 and 7.4 of the standard specified at § 170.210(h) when the encryption status of electronic health information locally stored by EHR technology on end-user devices is changed.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want the audit log to record the specified information when the encryption status of locally stored electronic health information changes, so that changes are traceable.

Given the audit log entry, when it is reviewed, then it contains the information specified in sections 7.2 and 7.4 of the standard specified at 170.210(h).
rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer. The standard is only referenced; the section symbol in the source is garbled.

requirement_text: The presence, or absence of, an NEFU ICP shall not impact the NE firmware (i.e., the NE firmware will not be different).
requirement_text_raw: The presence, or absence of, an NEFU ICP shall (3.2.5.2) not impact the NE firmware (i.e., the NE firmware will not be different).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the NE firmware to be the same whether or not an NEFU ICP is present, so that one firmware serves all configurations.
technical_task: Keep the NE firmware identical regardless of the presence or absence of an NEFU ICP.
acceptance_criteria: Given an NE with an NEFU ICP, when its firmware is checked, then it is the same firmware as in an NE without one.
Given an NE without an NEFU ICP, when its firmware is checked, then it is the same firmware as in an NE with one.

requirement_text: The contractor shall start environmental qualification that early in time schedule, that all tests are finished and a complete qualification report is available for PPF Sample.
user_story: As a project manager, I want the contractor to start environmental qualification early enough that all tests are finished and a complete qualification report exists for the PPF Sample, so that the sample can be released.
technical_task: Schedule the start of environmental qualification so that all tests are finished and a complete qualification report is available for the PPF Sample.
acceptance_criteria: Given the time schedule, when the PPF Sample is due, then all environmental qualification tests are finished.
Given the PPF Sample, when it is due, then a complete qualification report is available.

requirement_text: The scheduler shall execute all the tasks in each of the rate groups that have been installed in the current mode.
requirement_text_raw: The scheduler shall [SRS198] execute all the tasks in each of the rate groups that have been installed in the current mode.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the scheduler to execute all tasks of each rate group installed in the current mode, so that every installed task runs.
technical_task: Run every task in each rate group that is installed in the current mode.
acceptance_criteria: Given rate groups installed in the current mode, when the scheduler runs, then all their tasks are executed.
Given a rate group not installed in the current mode, when the scheduler runs, then its tasks are not executed.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to search for available distributed location templates(if any).
user_story: As a user, I want to search for available distributed location templates, if there are any, so that I can reuse them.
technical_task: Offer a search for available distributed location templates.
acceptance_criteria: Given available distributed location templates, when the user searches, then matching templates are listed.
Given no distributed location templates, when the user searches, then no templates are listed.

requirement_text: HTML code generates the cart display based on the current contents of the cart.
user_story: As a customer, I want the cart display to show the current contents of my cart, so that I see what I will buy.
technical_task: Generate the cart display with HTML from the current contents of the cart.
acceptance_criteria: Given items in the cart, when the cart is displayed, then it shows the current contents.
Given the cart changes, when it is displayed again, then it shows the updated contents.

requirement_text: System shall display the video in full screen resolution.
user_story: As a viewer, I want the video displayed in full screen resolution, so that I can see it large.
technical_task: Display videos at full screen resolution.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video, when the viewer chooses full screen, then it is displayed at full screen resolution.
Given a video displayed in full screen, when it plays, then it fills the screen.

requirement_text: System shall deny access and display an error message if the ID card is invalid.
user_story: As a cardholder, I want access denied and an error message shown when my ID card is invalid, so that I know why I cannot enter.
technical_task: Refuse access and show an error message for an invalid ID card.
acceptance_criteria: Given an invalid ID card, when it is presented, then access is denied.
Given an invalid ID card, when access is denied, then an error message is displayed.

requirement_text: User shall be able to log in with their email and password and receive a message indicating successful sign-in.
user_story: As a user, I want to log in with my email and password and see a message that sign-in succeeded, so that I know I am in.
technical_task: Provide login by email and password with a success message after sign-in.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email and password, when the user logs in, then the user is signed in.
Given a successful sign-in, when it completes, then a message indicates successful sign-in.

requirement_text: User shall provide valid details to create an account on the STM website.
user_story: As a new user, I want to provide valid details to create an account on the STM website, so that I can use the site.
technical_task: Require valid details when an account is created on the STM website.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid details, when the user creates an account, then the account is created.
Given invalid details, when the user tries to create an account, then no account is created.

requirement_text: User shall report inappropriate content if encountered.
user_story: As a user, I want to report inappropriate content I encounter, so that it can be reviewed.
technical_task: Add a report function for inappropriate content.
acceptance_criteria: Given a piece of content, when the user reports it as inappropriate, then the report is saved.
Given a saved report, when it is reviewed, then it identifies the reported content.

requirement_text: It has to be assured that it is not possible to get a badly calculated engine position (and as a result injections at incorrect angular positions) even if the crank signal is disrupted intermittently.
user_story: As a powertrain engineer, I want to be sure a badly calculated engine position cannot occur even if the crank signal is disrupted intermittently, so that injections happen at correct angular positions.
technical_task: Make the engine position calculation robust against intermittent crank signal disruptions so that incorrect injection angles cannot result.
acceptance_criteria: Given the crank signal is disrupted intermittently, when the engine position is calculated, then it is not badly calculated.
Given the engine position, when injections are triggered, then they occur at correct angular positions.

requirement_text: The healthcare portal shall have high availability, with minimal downtime for scheduled maintenance and updates.
user_story: As a patient, I want the healthcare portal highly available with minimal downtime for scheduled maintenance and updates, so that I can reach it when needed.
technical_task: Run the healthcare portal for high availability and keep downtime for scheduled maintenance and updates as short as possible.
acceptance_criteria: Given normal operation, when a patient opens the portal, then it is available.
Given scheduled maintenance or an update, when it takes place, then the downtime is kept minimal.
rationale: Role assumed: patient. "High availability" and "minimal downtime" are not quantified.

requirement_text: Support Services shall use no more than 5.2 milliseconds of FCP processing time to move the telemetry data to the FCC-MPCC board and complete communication and error handling for the FCC-MPCC board.
requirement_text_raw: Support Services shall [SRS257] use no more than 5.2 milliseconds of FCP processing time to move the telemetry data to the FCC-MPCC board and complete communication and error handling for the FCC-MPCC board.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Support Services to use at most 5.2 milliseconds of FCP processing time to move telemetry data to the FCC-MPCC board and handle communication and errors, so that FCP time is bounded.
technical_task: Limit Support Services use of FCP processing time to 5.2 milliseconds for moving telemetry data to the FCC-MPCC board and completing communication and error handling for it.
acceptance_criteria: Given telemetry data is moved to the FCC-MPCC board, when the FCP processing time of Support Services is measured, then it is no more than 5.2 milliseconds.
Given communication and error handling for the FCC-MPCC board, when they are included in the measurement, then the total is still no more than 5.2 milliseconds.

requirement_text: System shall be able to delete user location information nightly via a cron job.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want user location information deleted every night by a cron job, so that it is not kept longer than needed.
technical_task: Schedule a nightly cron job that deletes stored user location information.
acceptance_criteria: Given stored user location information, when the nightly cron job runs, then it is deleted.
Given location information stored after the job has run, when the next night comes, then it is deleted by the next run.

requirement_text: Website must be connected to a web server to make it available worldwide.
user_story: As a site owner, I want the website connected to a web server, so that it is available worldwide.
technical_task: Connect the website to a web server that makes it reachable worldwide.
acceptance_criteria: Given the website, when it is deployed, then it is connected to a web server.
Given the web server, when a user anywhere accesses the website, then the website is available.

requirement_text: The system shall be available at all times, only restricted by server downtime, and show a replacement page in case of hardware failure or database corruption.
user_story: As a user, I want the system available at all times except for server downtime, and a replacement page shown when hardware fails or the database is corrupted, so that I see something useful instead of an error.
technical_task: Keep the system continuously available except during server downtime, and show a replacement page on hardware failure or database corruption.
acceptance_criteria: Given the server is up, when a user opens the system, then it is available.
Given a hardware failure or database corruption, when a user requests a page, then a replacement page is shown.

user_story: As a patient, I want my login credentials and patient data kept secure and confidential, so that my information is protected.
technical_task: Store and handle login credentials and patient data with confidentiality controls.
acceptance_criteria: Given login credentials, when they are stored, then they are protected.
Given patient data, when an unauthorized person tries to read it, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: patient. The mechanisms are not specified.

user_story: As a security officer, I want protection mechanisms for sensitive data sent over the network, so that it is not exposed.
technical_task: Apply protection mechanisms to sensitive data transmitted over the network.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive data to be sent over the network, when it is sent, then a protection mechanism is applied.
Given sensitive data on the network, when an unauthorized party intercepts it, then it cannot be read.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The mechanisms are not listed.

requirement_text: System Initialization shall , when all other activities are completed, start the 50 Hz timer and enable the timer interrupt. This will allow the interrupt handler to initiate normal activities.
requirement_text_raw: System Initialization shall [SRS199], when all other activities are completed, start the 50 Hz timer and enable the timer interrupt.  This will allow the interrupt handler to initiate normal activities.

acceptance_criteria: Given all other initialization activities are completed, when System Initialization continues, then it starts the 50 Hz timer.
Given the 50 Hz timer is started, when System Initialization continues, then the timer interrupt is enabled so the interrupt handler can initiate normal activities.

requirement_text: The scope of FDIR shall be limited to the hardware on the four FCP boards, the four MPCC/CTC boards, the five ICPs, and the five NEs.
requirement_text_raw: The scope of FDIR shall (3.3.5.1) be limited to the hardware on the four FCP boards, the four MPCC/CTC boards, the five ICPs, and the five NEs.
